description:
Beautifully presented, three bedroom apartment with outside space.

Description

A modern and well-presented three bedroom apartment set on the third floor of a contemporary development, offering bright and spacious accommodation throughout.

The heart of the home is an impressive open-plan reception room and kitchen, providing an excellent space for both relaxing and entertaining. The sleek, contemporary kitchen is fitted with integrated appliances and ample storage, while floor-to-ceiling glazing allows for an abundance of natural light and opens onto a private balcony overlooking the attractive communal courtyard.

The principal bedroom benefits from fitted storage and an en suite shower room. Two further bedrooms provide flexible accommodation, ideal for guests or a home office. A stylish family bathroom, generous hallway storage and a well-designed layout complete the accommodation.

Residents enjoy access to beautifully maintained communal terrace, while the apartment's modern specification and excellent proportions make it ideally suited to contemporary city living.

This attractive apartment combines generous living space, a private balcony and a sought-after modern setting, creating a wonderful home for tenants seeking both comfort and convenience.

This property has cladding, as far as we know the current position with the property is: It’s been tested and there are no works required.

* You should make enquires about the external wall system of the property, if it has cladding and if it is safe or if there are interim measure in place.

Location

Matcham Buildings is located in the hear of London Fields, known for its vibrant community and excellent local amenities. The area offers an array of independent cafés, restaurants and boutique shops, alongside well-known favourites along nearby Mare Street and Broadway Market.

London Fields itself provides expansive green open space, ideal for outdoor leisure, with the added benefit of the popular lido. The Regent’s Canal is also within easy reach, offering scenic walks towards Victoria Park and beyond.

Transport links are superb, with London Fields Overground station providing direct access into the City, while nearby Hackney Central and Bethnal Green stations further enhance connectivity.

The area combines a lively East London atmosphere with convenient access to central London, making it popular with both professionals and families alike.

Square Footage: 1,091 sq ft
